title: Accommodation Marketplace
description: A web marketplace for short-term accommodation, in the style of Airbnb, connecting hosts and guests: listings, search, availability, quotes, bookings and cancellations. We built it as a team using Scrum, with Jira and Confluence. I worked on requirements, user stories and diagrams, and the repository runs a CI pipeline on GitHub Actions with code quality analysis in SonarCloud.

title: BlueLock Champions
company: Prototype · Diploma in Video Game Design and Development
description: A FIFA-style football game prototype featuring Blue Lock characters, built in Unity. I made it in one month as the final project of my game design and development course. It's a very basic version, but it was my first game built from start to finish.
